meaning:
οἰκονομία, -ας, ἡ
(οἰκονομέω), [in LXX: Isa.22:19, 21 (מַצָּב, מֶמְשָׁלָה)* ;]
1. prop. (Plat., Arist.), the office of οἰκονόμος, stewardship: Luk.16:2-4.
2. In later writers (Plut., al.; see AR on Eph.1:10; MM, xviii), generally, administration, dispensation: 1Co.9:17, Eph.1:10 3:2, 9, Col.1:25, 1Ti.1:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.
of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,
and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes, rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith—
